art_style: Precise geometric one-color-first VIB monogram with integral version path; consistent stroke widths and negative space; no gradients or generic Git icons

lettermark.reason: VIB is the approved exact wordmark; integrated checkpoint path makes it meaningful.

combination mark.reason: An integrated monogram can be paired with accessible full name and dual-line slogans.

abstract mark.reason: Version path expresses workflow, but a standalone abstract symbol would weaken acronym recognition.

mascot.reason: Does not communicate structured engineering or small-size legibility.

concepts.art_style: One-color-first custom angular vector geometry; flat Cobalt Precision accent only after silhouette
concepts.example: A single angular ribbon forms readable V, I and B with three integral checkpoint nodes; an open terminal implies advance.
concepts.rationale: Strong continuity; nodes must stay legible without looking like electronics.

concepts.art_style: One-color-first custom angular vector geometry; flat Cobalt Precision accent only after silhouette
concepts.example: Custom interlocking V, I and B share stems; a restrained rectangular cut and an open endpoint form an issue-to-checkpoint path.
concepts.rationale: Best connection to name and checkpoint mechanism; avoid ambiguous letter overlaps.

concepts.art_style: One-color-first custom angular vector geometry; flat Cobalt Precision accent only after silhouette
concepts.example: Three distinct angular letterforms align on a stepped baseline; negative-space transitions trace ordered progress.
concepts.rationale: Ordered progress and a robust silhouette; keep steps from resembling a bar chart.

concepts.art_style: One-color-first custom angular vector geometry; flat Cobalt Precision accent only after silhouette
concepts.example: The V is an asymmetric fork that leads into I and B through a single connected geometry; one small endpoint marks the decision.
concepts.rationale: Expresses branch architecture; avoid generic Git branch imagery.

concepts.art_style: One-color-first custom angular vector geometry; flat Cobalt Precision accent only after silhouette
concepts.example: Three independent but visually linked geometric V, I and B glyphs pass a checkpoint along the same axis, with a final open terminal.
concepts.rationale: Build, Verify, Advance in three stages; maintain visual unity at avatar size.

selection_reason: Agent-ranked working lead 95/100; Version Relay 92/100. Owner approved exploration of the hybrid direction and all five separate mockups, not a final logo; scores are written-concept judgments only.

confirmation.reference: VIB-BRAND-FOUNDATION-001 — explicit owner approval, 2026-11-24, of the proposed naming, Cobalt Precision, hybrid Version Monogram + Version Path, and dual-line slogans.

approval_scope: Foundation and five draft mockups only; final artwork, rights clearance, repo rename, rollout and product release not approved.
